name: Ren Nishimura
source:
A young expert on the virus. Ren is kind of a research nerd: arriving at work earlier than anyone else, and the last person to leave the lab. Research isn't simply inseparable from Ren's daily life; it is his daily life. Polite and gentle. However, he seems to be a difficult person as well. He shows his different dise facing mysterious events in the island...

Favorites: Spicy food
Dislikes: Idiots
Hobby: Research
Skill: Study and sports
